The School Board will conduct random,   unannounced screening of all designated employees   (i.e., those in safety-sensitive positions.)

The School Board will conduct random, unannounced screening of a non-designated employee only when said employee undergoes counseling, participates in a rehabilitation program for substance abuse, or is suspended or otherwise disciplined for violations of this policy.

All employees will be required to submit to substance abuse screening when a supervisor or school system official has reasonable suspicion that the employee has violated the School Boardls substance abuse policy.
This reasonable suspicion must be based on specific, contemporaneous, particular observations concerning the employeels appearance, behavior, speech, or body odor.

Substance abuse tests are authorized for reasonable suspicion only if the required observations are made during, just before, or just after the period of the workday when the employee must comply with substance abuse prohibitions.
